snapshot.reason: Perion Network has agreed to be acquired by Affle 3i in an all-cash merger valued at $420 million, setting a direct cash floor for equity holders.
snapshot.why_now: Definitive merger agreement announced on November 1, 2026.
source_headlines: Affle 3i Limited: Affle 3i Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 01, 2026, titled "Affle to acquire Perion, to scale its CPCU business across Developed markets".

Affle 3i Limited: Affle 3i Limited has informed the Exchange that Affle 3iL Ltd. ( Affle ), wholly owned step down subsidiary of the Company has entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Perion Network Ltd., Israel.
Affle 3i to acquire Israel's Perion Network for $420 million in all-cash deal
